name: Scheduling Lab
desc: Five dispatch rules over identical machines with live Gantt charts, tardiness accounting and a makespan lower bound.
controls: Job count, machines, processing spread and deadline slack sliders, four preset profiles, reshuffle and next-rule buttons, clickable Gantt blocks and job chips; Space cycles the rule, R reshuffles, 1–5 pick a rule
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
